intent: Selbstregistrierung, Wartestatus und Personenzuordnung durch Admin
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity Flutter theater app UI design board with three large portrait screens side by side on a warm ivory canvas, flat frontal presentation, crisp German text.
Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match its calm Rampenlicht visual language: ivory #F8F6F0, dark forest #202823, restrained orange #E96131 for primary actions, sage and amber status colors, rounded understated cards, clear sans-serif typography. No photography, device hardware or perspective.
Primary request: design self registration, waiting for administrator approval, and the administrator's account-to-person linking workflow. Keep screens minimal and easy to read, ample spacing and short copy. Do not put technical implementation or Firebase text in the product.
LEFT SCREEN: small orange theater-mask mark and "Rampenlicht"; heading "Konto erstellen". Two prominent outlined full-width buttons "Mit Google fortfahren", "Mit Apple fortfahren"; a quiet link "Weitere Anmeldearten" with chevron (other providers are behind this entry, don't list them). A separator "oder per E-Mail". Fields "Name", "E-Mail", "Passwort" with sample name "Sam Weber" and email "sam@example.com", password obscured. Orange primary button "Konto erstellen". Short subdued sentence "Die Theaterleitung gibt dein Konto anschließend frei." Footer "Schon registriert? Anmelden". No bottom app navigation before approval.
MIDDLE SCREEN: header "Rampenlicht" and a small profile circle "SW". Minimal centered outlined clock icon in amber, large heading "Freigabe ausstehend", then "Dein Konto ist erstellt. Die Theaterleitung ordnet dich einer Person zu und gibt deinen Zugang frei." A compact pale card "Sam Weber", "sam@example.com", sage verified chip "E-Mail bestätigt". A two-step vertical progression: green check "Konto erstellt", amber clock "Freigabe ausstehend". A calm outlined button "Status aktualisieren", secondary text "Abmelden". No member list, plays or main navigation. Enough open space, no useless hints.
RIGHT SCREEN: back arrow, header "Konto freigeben", small "Admin" pill. Account card "Sam Weber", "sam@example.com", "E-Mail bestätigt", amber "Ausstehend". Section title "Person zuordnen"; search/select field "Person suchen"; one chosen member card with avatar "SW", "Sam Weber", subline "Ensemble · Mitglied Nr. 014", orange selection check. Label "Zugriff" with selected role "Mitglied", small "Ändern" link. Anchored orange primary button "Verknüpfen & freigeben". Separate quiet action "Anfrage ablehnen". There is no automatic name/email match; the visible member is explicitly selected by the admin. Do not show the account as approved before pressing button.
Small labels below panels: "Registrierung", "Wartestatus", "Admin-Freigabe". Bottom board caption "Entwurf mit Beispieldaten". German umlauts correct; text must fit in realistic phone widths with at least 48 logical pixel touch target intent. No other screens and no polling or calendar voting.
